description: Inspect or request the current gateway session's execution backend. Backends are 'local' plus configured SSH targets. Actions mirror the gateway /ssh command: status, list, test, use, on, off. The model may request use <backend>; if that backend is off for auto-switching, Hermes requests user approval instead of switching silently. on/off are user-owned permission changes and the model cannot use them to grant itself access.
name: ssh_mode

backend.description: Backend name: 'local' or a configured SSH target alias.

cwd.description: Optional remote working directory override for SSH backend use.

reason.description: Short user-visible reason for switching backends.
